latestFormalFinding.boundary: R113 records a PARTIAL_RETURN visibility pattern under the declared reversed memory-access intervention. The verified matched-parent control shows that, with task and intervention held constant, changing the formal parent changes provenance but not participant/silent selection under the formal v0.9 baseline. Therefore PARTIAL_RETURN is a descriptive return-pattern measurement, not evidence of visibility path dependence in the current deterministic formal rule.

latestExperimentalControl.boundary: Isolated counterfactual executor only. It deliberately includes parent round ordinal in participant selection and has been CI-verified against R111 and R112. It does not write or advance formal greenhouse history and is engineering evidence that NOSTROMO can execute and audit a parent-sensitive transition, not evidence that the real SHROOMING population is causally path-dependent.

latestThickening.boundary: VAJRA v0.2.8 was promoted only after the dedicated adversarial test and full NOSTROMO GitHub Actions run succeeded. Compound claims can now be split by bounded syntactic causal patterns into clause-scoped references, and a receipt about one clause cannot structurally close a branch scoped to another clause. Clause splitting, lens choice and receipt closure remain deterministic auditable heuristics; they are not semantic parsing, factual verification, or proof that a proposition is settled.

shrooming.boundary: Published-state inspection, sandbox reading, greenhouse question probing, and explicit formal greenhouse round advancement are executable. RUN_READING_ROUND remains the verified parent-invariant v0.9 formal baseline and is chainable from a declared formal parent. The verified R111→R112→R113 chain preserves provenance and legacy R111 reproducibility. An isolated parent-sensitive counterfactual executor is also verified; it deliberately makes participant selection depend on parent round ordinal but never mutates formal greenhouse history. Neither branch represents ten independently persistent live LLM processes, and the experimental branch must not be presented as evidence of real path dependence.

muther.boundary: Published mining-state audit and repository corpus mining are closed-loop executable. Query-scoped Google Drive mining is executed by the authorized external connector runtime and handed back as redacted evidence. MINE_INTERNAL is executable only over an explicitly authorized connector source with an explicit query and bounded result count; the current verified source is Google Drive. This does not grant exhaustive private-environment crawling, cross-source enumeration, or access to unconnected services. FALSIFY executes a repository-scoped counterevidence probe; absence is never upgraded to truth.

droplet.boundary: Published evidence audit and explicit-URL verification are executable. Search-engine discovery is executed by the external web connector runtime. VERIFY executes a deterministic claim verdict over an explicit connector-supplied evidence bundle and returns SUPPORTED, REFUTED, or INDETERMINATE with provenance fingerprints. It does not search the web by itself and absence of refutation is not global truth.

gut.boundary: GUT v0.2.14 classifies and routes material, quarantines failure/risk markers, preserves uncertainty, propagates provenance, removes exact inherited substrate echoes when caller context is supplied, strips route metadata, suppresses exact repeated tagged payloads and same-tag long tails, collapses exact adjacent segments before and after tagged processing, and suppresses repeated long shared bodies in summary selection without deleting source nutrients. Near-duplicates that are not exact matches remain. JSON-like engineering snippets are downgraded before lexical contradiction detection. It remains heuristic: paraphrastic echo, semantic novelty, source truth and optimal routing are not certified.

vajra.boundary: VAJRA v0.2.8 performs proposition-aware dynamic dismantling, retains multiple lexically detected proposition types, and applies bounded syntactic clause decomposition for explicit causal forms. OPEN branch contracts carry targetRef plus clauseRef and still require matching lens, preferred organ, execution status, provenance, material and relation-to-target before structural closure. A receipt scoped to a different clause is rejected and remains visible in the audit trail. The same provenance+material payload can resolve only one branch across accumulated VAJRA history. Clause decomposition, type detection and RESOLVED_BY_RECEIPT are structural heuristics, not semantic parsing, factual truth, or proof that the original proposition is settled.
